turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor: Here is the rule. After he, she or it, the verb takes -s: "She likes tea", not "She like tea". Add -es after sh, ch, s, x and o (watches, goes) and change consonant + y to -ies (studies). Do not add -s after I, you, we or they.
